metadata.title: TeamForge — Unity Editor 的开源实时协作
metadata.description: TeamForge 是一个针对 Unity Editor 的早期开源实时协作项目，探索实时场景同步、在线状态 (Presence)、层级协作、锁定以及 P2P 项目引导 (Bootstrap)。
metadata.ogTitle: TeamForge — Unity Editor 的实时协作
metadata.ogDescription: Unity Editor 协作的早期公开源码预览：实时场景同步、在线状态、层级协作、锁定以及 P2P 项目引导。

replacements.source: If a search result, cached assistant answer, GitHub page, and this site disagree, compare project.json's sourceCommit with the current repository default branch and check release-contract.json for the current candidate identity. The repository manifest inventories every tracked file at that exact commit; search and crawl indexes can still lag behind the repository.
replacements.target: 如果搜索结果、缓存的助手回答、GitHub 页面和本站点存在分歧，请将 project.json 的 sourceCommit 与当前仓库默认分支进行比较，并检查 release-contract.json 以获取当前的候选身份。仓库清单记录了该确切提交时的每个受跟踪文件；搜索和爬取索引可能仍然落后于仓库。

replacements.source: Move it once. See it twice.
TeamForge does not try to replace Git or Unity Version Control. It works on the moments when two people are already inside the Editor and need shared context.
replacements.target: TeamForge 不试图取代 Git 或 Unity Version Control。它处理的是两个人已经在编辑器中并需要共享上下文的时刻。
eventText.textContent='移动已提交 · 两个编辑器已同步'

replacements.source: Locking & ownershipMake editing intent visible and reduce collisions with server-authoritative ownership.
replacements.target: 锁定与所有权使编辑意图可见，并通过服务器授权控制的所有权减少冲突。
仅用于演示 · 真实捕获 ↓

replacements.source: Try it: drag the Cube, then lock/unlock it. The peer state and transform values stay in step.
replacements.target: 试一试：拖动立方体，然后锁定/解锁它。对等端状态和 Transform 值保持同步。

replacements.source: Build together. Stay in sync. TeamForge is an open-source real-time collaboration project for the Unity Editor. It focuses on the awkward part between source-control commits: seeing each other, sharing supported Scene edits, avoiding collisions, and getting another machine into the project.
replacements.target: 共同构建。保持同步。 TeamForge 是一个针对 Unity Editor 的开源实时协作项目。它专注于源代码控制提交之间那个棘手的阶段：看到彼此、共享受支持的场景编辑、避免冲突，以及让另一台机器加入项目。

replacements.source: Built in public, failure by failure.
replacements.target: 公开构建，直面每一次失败。

replacements.source: Transform syncSynchronize supported Scene transform changes between connected Editor instances.
replacements.target: Transform 同步在连接的编辑器实例之间同步受支持的场景 Transform 更改。

replacements.source: Historical snapshots: older source/build snapshots may exist outside the current supported source tree. Selected snapshots can later be published as clearly marked unsupported archival releases when useful for comparison or research.
replacements.target: 历史快照：较旧的源码/构建快照可能存在于当前受支持的源码树之外。选定的快照稍后可以在对比较或研究有用时，作为明确标记为不受支持的归档版本发布。

实时协作
面向 Unity Editor。
编辑器 B · Peer Guest · 跟随

replacements.source: Status: Early Public Preview — do not use TeamForge as the only copy or recovery mechanism for an important Unity project.
replacements.target: 状态：早期公开预览 — 请勿将 TeamForge 用作重要 Unity 项目的唯一副本或恢复机制。

replacements.source: It started with two Editors and one question.
replacements.target: 它始于两个编辑器和一个问题。

replacements.source: Connection foundations, diagnostics, identity, connected-user presence, selection, and Scene awareness.
replacements.target: 连接基础、诊断、身份、已连接用户的在线状态、选择和场景感知。

replacements.source:
>Not audited

Production trust

Important projects should still be backed up, and testing should prefer disposable or recoverable projects.
replacements.target:
>未审计

生产环境信任度

重要项目仍应进行备份，测试应优先使用一次性或可恢复的项目。

replacements.source: Useful now. Not pretending to be finished.
replacements.target: 现在可用。不假装已完成。

replacements.source: Hierarchy collaborationCreate, delete, rename, reparent, and sibling-order synchronization for the same Scene.
replacements.target: 层级协作对同一场景进行创建、删除、重命名、重新设置父级以及兄弟顺序同步。

replacements.source: Bootstrap, networking boundaries, release-contract checks, and security-related validation continue to tighten.
replacements.target: 引导 (Bootstrap)、网络边界、发布契约检查和安全相关验证继续收紧。

replacements.source:
>Available

Public source

Unity package, server, Project Peer, launcher, tests, architecture notes, and development records can be inspected directly.
replacements.target:
>可用

公开源码

Unity 包、服务器、Project Peer、启动器、测试、架构说明和开发记录可以直接检查。

replacements.source: Use current source/tests for implemented behavior, STATUS.md for readiness, release-contract.json for the current candidate contract, and exact artifact filename + SHA-256 for packaged byte identity.
replacements.target: 使用当前的源码/测试来了解已实现的行为，使用 STATUS.md 了解就绪状态，使用 release-contract.json 了解当前的候选契约，并使用确切的制品文件名 + SHA-256 来验证打包后的字节一致性。

replacements.source: Two Unity Editor instances connected through TeamForge and sharing Editor changes. The capture is evidence of the prototype, not a production-readiness claim.
replacements.target: 两个 Unity Editor 实例通过 TeamForge 连接并共享编辑器更改。该捕获是原型的证据，而非生产就绪声明。

replacements.source: The repository keeps the trail instead of presenting TeamForge as a mysterious finished code drop.
replacements.target: 仓库保留了开发轨迹，而不是将 TeamForge 呈现为一个神秘的已完成代码包。

replacements.source: Joining the project should be part of collaboration too.
replacements.target: 加入项目也应该是协作的一部分。

replacements.source: Integrity & recoveryResume, validation, diagnostics, stale-operation refusal, and recovery paths are treated as core behavior.
replacements.target: 完整性与恢复恢复 (Resume)、验证、诊断、拒绝陈旧操作以及恢复路径被视为核心行为。

replacements.source: Same-Scene create, delete, rename, reparent, ordering, authority, tombstones, and conflict handling.
replacements.target: 同场景创建、删除、重命名、重新设置父级、排序、授权控制、墓碑和冲突处理。

replacements.source: Work-state notes preserve failures, investigations, and follow-up changes between named milestones.
replacements.target: 工作状态说明保留了命名里程碑之间的失败、调查和后续更改。

replacements.source: Transform synchronization, server-authoritative revisions, late-join state, and basic locking.
replacements.target: Transform 同步、服务器授权控制的修订、后加入状态和基本锁定。

replacements.source: Presence & awarenessSee connected collaborators and useful Editor context instead of working blind.
replacements.target: 在线状态与感知查看已连接的协作者和有用的编辑器上下文，而不是盲目工作。

replacements.source: A compact verification shelf for people, search engines, AI tools, and maintainers. It keeps the current source, release candidate, and canonical evidence visible without turning the homepage into a documentation index.
replacements.target: 这是一个供用户、搜索引擎、AI 工具和维护者快速核对当前状态的精简验证区域。它显示当前源码、发布候选和规范证据，同时避免把主页变成文档索引。

replacements.source: Could two Unity Editor instances collaborate more directly without pretending source control solves every live collaboration problem?
replacements.target: 两个 Unity Editor 实例能否更直接地协作，而不假装源代码控制能解决所有实时协作问题？

replacements.source:
>Not yet

General installable alpha

No packaged build is currently recommended to general users. A Git URL is not being treated as a complete end-user release.
replacements.target:
>尚未

通用可安装 Alpha

目前不向普通用户推荐任何打包构建。Git URL 不被视为完整的最终用户版本。

replacements.source: Drag the selected Cube in Editor A. Editor B mirrors the position immediately. Toggle ownership to see how a collaboration lock changes the peer's state. This web interaction is a simplified illustration of the product idea; the real development capture follows below.
replacements.target: 在编辑器 A 中拖动选定的立方体。编辑器 B 会立即镜像该位置。切换所有权以查看协作锁如何更改对等端的状态。此 Web 交互是产品理念的简化演示；真实的开发捕获紧随其后。

replacements.target: alt="TeamForge 演示显示两个 Unity Editor 实例实时共享更改"

replacements.source: Working pieces exist and are tested, while distribution and field validation still come before a general alpha recommendation.
replacements.target: 可用的部分已经存在并经过测试，而分发和实际验证仍然优先于通用 Alpha 推荐。

replacements.source: Early public preview. Source and engineering records are public, but TeamForge is still being stabilized and is not yet presented as a general installable production release.
replacements.target: 早期公开预览。 源码和工程记录是公开的，但 TeamForge 仍在稳定中，尚未作为通用的可安装生产版本发布。

replacements.source: P2P project bootstrapMove the project state another developer needs to join without turning bootstrap into a manual checklist.
replacements.target: P2P 项目引导移动另一个开发者加入所需的项目状态，而无需将引导变成手动检查清单。

replacements.source: P2P transfer foundations, signed invites, integrity validation, Embedded UPM handling, retry, and failover.
replacements.target: P2P 传输基础、签名邀请、完整性验证、嵌入式 UPM 处理、重试和故障转移。

replacements.source: TeamForge is an experimental open-source project licensed under GNU AGPLv3. The working name, feature set, compatibility, and release-readiness may change during development.
replacements.target: TeamForge 是一个根据 GNU AGPLv3 许可的实验性开源项目。工作名称、功能集、兼容性和发布就绪状态在开发过程中可能会发生变化。

replacements.target:
